params.body:
The Workbench page pre-ticked a project in the working set only when it had no admission at all. On 6 October the owner admitted the set's two projects with one touch; Stocklist already had an admission for that day, so it was not ticked and stayed admitted until midnight instead of until the set's end.

A project in the set is now ticked whenever its current admission ends before the set does.

Tests: `WorkbenchAdmittedByPasskeyTest` covers a set project with an admission for today being ticked. The Workbench tests pass.
